status.label: Duplicate or handled
status.detail: Merged PR #37930 covers the generic-versus-sided Shift release bug.

judgment.rationale: Merged PR #37930 explicitly fixes modifier remaps that use an unsided Ctrl/Alt/Shift by tracking which physical side is pressed and releasing the correct key, matching this issue’s generic Shift versus right Shift trigger.
evidence: The repro only occurs when the shortcut uses generic Shift, not Shift (left) or Shift (right).
Right Shift triggers the stuck state, and pressing both Shift keys clears it.
PR #37930 merged on 2025-04-14 and states that generic modifier remaps could stick because VK_SHIFT was emitted instead of the physical right Shift.
judgment.recommended_action: Close as fixed by #37930, with a request to file a current-version regression only if the exact sequence still fails.

fix_assessment.rationale: PR #37930 implemented physical-side tracking for generic Ctrl/Alt/Shift remaps and correct key release, directly covering the reported mechanism.

issue_context.summary: A generic Shift shortcut remap could leave the physical right Shift logically pressed because the engine emitted generic VK_SHIFT state rather than preserving the actual left/right modifier.
known_information: The original issue supplied exact SHIFT+F1/F2 to F13/F14 steps and was maintainer-reproduced on 0.29.3.
The failure is specific to generic Shift combined with physical right Shift.
The merged fix describes the same generic-versus-sided modifier release mismatch.
inferences: The historical issue should be resolved in releases containing #37930; there is no newer comment showing recurrence.
issue_context.analysis: Unlike the prior generic request-info artifact, the public fix history identifies both the failure mechanism and a merged correction.
initial_investigation: Read all five comments and the full issue body through 2022-10-21T14:07:09Z.
Reviewed merged PR #37930 and current Keyboard Manager modifier-state code.
No post-fix recurrence is recorded on this issue.

comment.body: This historical repro matches the modifier-side bug fixed by merged PR #37930: a shortcut configured with generic `Shift` could receive physical Right Shift but release generic `VK_SHIFT`, leaving the real modifier logically pressed. The fix tracks the physical left/right Ctrl, Alt, and Shift key and releases the matching key. I suggest closing this as fixed. If the exact SHIFT+F1/F2 sequence still fails on a current PowerToys release, please open a fresh regression report with that version and sequence.

title: [KBM] Shift Right remains logically pressed in this particular scenario
